THE SECOND HAVEN APPROACH

A home. A community.
A chance to begin again.

Second Haven offers nonclinical recovery housing for adults building a life in recovery. The idea is simple: a substance-free home where residents take an active role in the life they share.

Our connection to animal rescue inspired the name—a belief in patience, dignity, and second chances. That same spirit shapes our approach to shared living.

Get to know the home

THE ROOMS & TERMS

Choose your space.
A home to share.

Shared and private options are offered in a three-bedroom, split-level townhome. Both options are unfurnished; bring your own bed and furnishings.

  • Shared master bedroom: $750 per person per month for a room space. The entire room measures 17 × 11 feet, approximately 187 square feet.
  • Private Bedroom 2: $900 per month for one resident. The room measures 9 × 11 feet, approximately 99 square feet.

Dimensions are owner-reported. Both rooms are on the lower level and require stairs. Common spaces and 1.5 bathrooms, including one shower, are shared. Ask JR about current roommates, household arrangements, and any access needs.

$750 security deposit per person; 3-month minimum rental term. Utilities, electricity, driveway parking, and scheduled weekly washer/dryer access are included. Pets considered case by case. Outdoor smoking only; no smoking indoors. Internet availability is being confirmed.

Available from October 3, 2026. Recovery-house expectations apply. JR will review current room availability, household arrangements, and written rental terms before any agreement or payment. Contact JR before visiting.

A LITTLE MORE CLARITY

Questions are
always welcome.

A few things to know about the rooms and shared household.

How is the household managed?+

Ask JR about current household arrangements, responsibilities, and recovery-house rules. Before any rental agreement, JR will explain the management arrangement and how residents can raise questions or concerns.

Is Second Haven a treatment facility?+

No. This is nonclinical recovery housing. It does not include detoxification, therapy, medical care, or around-the-clock staff supervision. Residents arrange any clinical care with outside providers.

Can I inquire now, and when could I move in?+

Yes. Shared master-bedroom space and private Bedroom 2 are available from October 3, 2026. Text JR at (424) 285-4489 to check current availability, discuss roommates, and arrange a viewing. An inquiry does not reserve a room or confirm admission; JR will review written terms before an agreement.

What does a room cost, and what is included?+

Shared master-bedroom space is $750 per person per month. Private Bedroom 2 is $900 per month for one resident. Both require a $750 security deposit per person and a 3-month minimum rental term. Both options are unfurnished; bring your own bed and furnishings. Utilities, electricity, driveway parking, and scheduled weekly washer/dryer access are included. Pets considered case by case. Outdoor smoking only; no smoking indoors. Internet availability is being confirmed. Written terms will be reviewed before any agreement or payment. Financial assistance is not currently confirmed.

What are the rooms and access like?+

The shared master bedroom measures 17 × 11 feet (approximately 187 square feet for the entire room). Private Bedroom 2 is 9 × 11 feet (approximately 99 square feet) and is offered for one resident. Dimensions are owner-reported. Both rooms are on the lower level, reached by stairs. Bathrooms and common spaces are shared, with 1.5 bathrooms and one shower. Discuss access needs, roommates, and current household arrangements with JR.

Where is the house, and can I visit?+

The home is at 2192 4th Avenue East, West Fargo, ND 58078. Contact JR before visiting to discuss viewing options.

How can I make a housing inquiry for someone?+

Call or text JR at (424) 285-4489 to ask about shared master-bedroom space or private Bedroom 2, available from October 3, 2026. Please keep an initial inquiry to contact details, room interest, and timing; do not send medical records by text. Confirm current availability and written requirements directly before arranging a move.
